facts.statement_en: Systematic review and pairwise meta-analysis of intervention studies.
Adults aged 18 years or older with asymptomatic severe aortic stenosis; early aortic valve replacement versus conservative management; efficacy outcomes.
Eligibility is specified in the accepted protocol; final-review methods are identified separately.
Adults aged 18 years or older with asymptomatic severe aortic stenosis; early aortic valve replacement versus conservative management; efficacy outcomes.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: ELIGIBILITY; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Include prospective randomized controlled trials of adults aged 18 years or older with asymptomatic severe aortic stenosis that compare early surgical or transcatheter aortic valve replacement with conservative management and report an eligible Review outcome. Extract endpoint definitions, participant event counts and arm denominators at the longest eligible follow-up available by the Review cutoff.
status: NOT_REPORTED; method_domain: SELECTION_PROCESS; method_basis: UNCLEAR_MIXED; description: The bound review did not report a complete reviewer-based selection process.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: DATA_COLLECTION; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Two reviewers will independently extract data into a structured Microsoft Excel 2017 form. Fields will include author, year, study design and region, population and sample size, follow-up duration, severity of aortic stenosis, baseline and echocardiographic characteristics, surgical or transcatheter intervention, comparator details, heart-failure or cardiovascular hospitalization where reported, and all eligible outcomes. Disagreements will be resolved through discussion and consensus with a third reviewer.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: RISK_OF_BIAS; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Risk of bias will be assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 1 tool, covering selection, performance, detection, attrition, reporting, and other bias.
status: REPORTED; method_domain: EFFECT_MEASURE; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: The review used risk ratio.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: SYNTHESIS_MODEL; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Dichotomous outcomes will be summarized as risk ratios with 95% confidence intervals using a fixed-effect primary model.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: HETEROGENEITY; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Heterogeneity will be assessed with Cochran's Q, using P below 0.10 as evidence of heterogeneity, and with I², interpreted as below 25% low, 25% to 50% moderate, and above 50% high heterogeneity.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: SUBGROUP; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Subgroup analysis will compare surgical with transcatheter aortic valve replacement.; Univariable random-effects meta-regression will examine age, body mass index, peak aortic jet velocity, and follow-up duration.
